description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayNodeSession component within the OpenClawKit project. It includes mock implementations of WebSocket tasks and sessions, setup/teardown logic for test environments, and various test cases verifying WebSocket connection behaviors, token handling, URL normalization, and event subscriptions.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking simulating a WebSocket connection for testing purposes.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session managing multiple fake WebSocketWebSocketTask instances for testing purposes.

classes.name: SeqGapProbe
classes.description: An actor class used to detect the occurrence of a 'seqGap' event during tests.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSessionTests
classes.description: A test suite for the GatewayNodeSession component, containing multiple test cases covering connection logic, token handling, URL normalization, and event subscriptions.

methods.name: scannedSetupCodePrefersBootstrapAuthOverStoredDeviceToken
methods.description: Verifies that the gateway connection uses the bootstrap token when establishing a session.

methods.name: bootstrapHelloStoresAdditionalDeviceTokens
methods.description: Tests that additional device tokens received during bootstrap are stored correctly.

methods.name: nonBootstrapHelloStoresPrimaryDeviceTokenButNotAdditionalBootstrapTokens
methods.description: Checks that primary device token is stored when not bootstrapping, and additional tokens are not persisted.

methods.name: untrustedBootstrapHelloDoesNotPersistBootstrapHandoffTokens
methods.description: Asserts that tokens received from an untrusted bootstrap do not get persisted for handoff.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlPreservesExplicitSecureCanvasPort
methods.description: Ensures URL normalization preserves explicitly specified HTTPS ports.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlBackfillsGatewayHostForLoopbackCanvas
methods.description: Verifies URL normalization correctly backfills the gateway host for local loopback URLs.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsUnderlyingResponseBeforeTimeout
methods.description: Tests that invokeWithTimeout returns the response before the timeout when the invocation completes early.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsTimeoutError
methods.description: Verifies that invokeWithTimeout returns a timeout error if the invocation exceeds the specified duration.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutZeroDisablesTimeout
methods.description: Checks that passing zero milliseconds disables the timeout in invokeWithTimeout.

methods.name: emitsSyntheticSeqGapAfterReconnectSnapshot
methods.description: Ensures that a synthetic 'seqGap' event is emitted after reconnection and snapshot handling.
